mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates applied to future equity cash flows and increasing the present value of S&P 500 earnings, leading to positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer confidence and corporate hiring expectations, which triggers a sell-off in equities due to near-term earnings risk, resulting in negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction permits (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a broad-based contraction in private demand, indicating weakening economic activity and reduced corporate revenue prospects, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction effect (joint IC) is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 for two consecutive months indicates a sharp contraction in manufacturing output, signaling a supply-side shock that reduces corporate profitability and increases recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) signals a collapse in aggregate demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and increasing the likelihood of earnings revisions downward, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 50% of instances where both RSAFS and GDPC1 decline, or the joint Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% combined with a sustained increase in CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) signals a tightening monetary cycle in response to inflation, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuation multiples, leading to negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the interaction effect (IC) is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rapid decline in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) below 50k per month, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 6.5%), signals a labor market slowdown that reduces consumer spending power and corporate hiring momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the joint Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in residential construction permits (HOUST) below 750k, combined with a decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS), indicates a collapse in housing and consumer demand, reducing business investment and earnings visibility, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < 750.0 and RSAFS declines for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the interaction IC is not significant (p > 0.05).
